The arithmetic mean of these terms is: $$ \frac{a_i + a_{i+1} + \cdots + a_{i+k-1}}{k} $$ This is an integer if and only if the sum of the block is divisible by \( k \). So the condition becomes: $$ j - i + 1 \mid S_j - S_{i-1} $$ We are looking for sequences where **no** such pair \( (i,j) \) with \( j - i + 1 \ge 2 \) satisfies this divisibility.
